bayts.text: For the Chosen One I have resolved upon what renews his radiant Sunna, and I am Aḥmad.
The Self-Sufficient (Aṣ-Ṣamad) helps me toward what is right, by the rank of the best of creation – what an excellent noble one!
The One (Al-Aḥad) sent the best of the worlds: what an excellent God, the Most Generous, the One Whose oneness is proclaimed!
To Allah be praise with thanks made everlasting for the duration of a beneficial dominion that He alone holds.
To Him is my address, praising Him, and He gives aid (in the service) of him through whom I head for the Gardens.
Grant me Your Book and lead to me what makes my joy everlasting, O Most Generous Whose oneness I proclaim.
Truly the Book that Muḥammad brought – may the Self-Sufficient bless him with peace –,
through it guidance and right conduct have yielded to us; through it we lean upon the Lord of creatures.
The Qurʾān has led to us what we find in no other: what an excellent Book, the most beneficial!
An Everlasting One has repelled what I loathe, and it reaches me no more; through it He makes my wishes everlasting.
Its verses drive toward others than us, without end, before he heads (for us), whoever lies in wait.
Toward others than us heads what afflicts, for ever; through it we reach the Gardens.
Muḥammad through it repelled toward others than us what afflicted us, and the Self-Sufficient repelled it.
A beautiful peace, by which aid endures, (be) upon a man of worth, trustworthy, praised.
An immense blessing that never runs out (be) upon a trustworthy one, known as such among the noble.
We have sought a greeting of peace, with a praise ever renewed, for a leader who is the obeyed, the most glorious.
O Allah, O Lord of creatures, O Self-Sufficient, O You through Whom noble worshippers were guided,
for him through whom aid came to them from You, make everlasting a blessing with a praised peace.
Whoever has sought one like Aḥmad does not find him: the like has not appeared and shall not appear.
Our Prophet, the Messenger Aḥmad, attained the pre-eminence (given) by Him Who is the Eternal, the One.
From his auspiciousness aid came to the noble: he is the imām and the most generous intercessor.
From our Lord, through him, ease endures for us, and toward others than us adversity heads.
The blessing of the Chosen One cannot be denied, and his blazing light is never extinguished.
From our Lord, through him, what most benefits endures for us, and toward others than us grief heads.
Our beloved, the Chosen One: his mastery is manifest, and what he attained is not found among the illustrious.
Muḥammad is the valiant, the support; he is the beautiful, the generous, the master.
Muḥammad is the noble, the unique; he is the Prophet and the Messenger who brings succour.
A religion other than his Islam is not praised with God, and through it we renew (faith).
